title: The Crescent

services.name: Night of 1,000 Jack-o'-Lanterns
services.desc: The Chicago Botanic Garden has 385 acres of nature, beauty, and respite to discover. Dare to walk an eerily enchanting path aglow with artist-carved pumpkins. Among them, 75 giants tip the scales at 150 pounds each. Watch live carving in action, meet costumed performers, and enjoy playful frights around every corner. Stop for seasonal treats and drinks like homemade caramel apples, spiced nuts, apple cider donuts, spirited cocktails, and more. blurb: Bold planting ideas are front and center in the Crescent's annual beds, while hundreds of evergreen boxwood give shape to their curves. The evergreens create a mass of green "steps" flanking the eight concentric tiers, which increase in size as they slope gently down to the water's edge.
